verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows WorkOS is an authentication platform with RBAC enforced 'through session JWTs' (workos-supp-rbac-jwt) and MFA support, but there is no documentation of session expiry configuration, refresh token flows, or an API/mechanism for immediate server-side revocation of a compromised session. Missing for full/partial credit: session expiry settings, refresh token rotation, and explicit session/token revocation endpoints or docs.
